page: Deploying Elysia on Vercel platform. Zero configuration deployment. Supports Bun and Node runtime. Default export Elysia instance from src/index.ts. Vercel CLI with vc dev for local development. vc deploy for deployment. Automatic platform detection and setup. Vercel Functions integration. Questions: How do I deploy to Vercel? What runtime is used? Do I need configuration?

sections.manifest: When Vercel deployment doesn't work. Zero-configuration support by Vercel. Additional configuration from Vercel documentation. Vercel documentation link for Elysia. Custom configuration options available. Questions: What do I do if deployment fails? Where is additional documentation?
